explanation: Less rain would make the short rains less reliable, which matters most for a second crop.
The long rains would still usually support maize, but with more stress.

addRisk.text: Maize could suffer from dry spells during the long rains.

current-maize-only.summary: More dry-spell stress on the single maize crop.

alt-maize-bean.feasibilityReason: The short-rains bean crop becomes less reliable with less rain.

addRisk.text: Beans in the short rains may fail in a dry year.

alt-maize-bean.summary: The bean crop becomes the weak point.

alt-maize-lablab.summary: Lablab is generally drought tolerant; little change in this illustrative view.

explanation: More rain could help the short-rains crop, but very wet conditions can increase some plant diseases.

current-maize-only.summary: Little change for a long-rains maize crop in this illustrative view.

addRisk.text: Wet conditions can increase bean leaf diseases.

alt-maize-bean.summary: Short rains become more reliable for beans, with some disease risk.

alt-maize-lablab.summary: More rain may help lablab establish.

explanation: At this cool altitude, warmer temperatures could speed up crop growth.
Warmer conditions can also bring new pests and increase water loss.

addRisk.text: Warmer highlands may see more maize pests.

current-maize-only.summary: Faster growth, but possibly more pests — direction unclear.

addRisk.text: Heat at flowering can reduce bean pod setting.

alt-maize-lablab.feasibilityReason: Warmer temperatures may suit lablab better at this altitude.
alt-maize-lablab.summary: The cool-temperature concern for lablab is reduced.

explanation: Hotter and drier conditions together would put the most pressure on rain-fed crops.
Drought-tolerant options are generally less exposed in this illustrative view.

current-maize-only.feasibilityReason: Maize may face both heat and water stress.

addRisk.text: Higher chance of maize yield loss.

alt-maize-bean.feasibilityReason: Both crops face more stress; beans are sensitive to drought.

addRisk.text: The bean crop may fail in the short rains.

alt-maize-lablab.feasibilityReason: Lablab is drought tolerant and suits warmer conditions.
alt-maize-lablab.summary: Lablab may cope best of the three.
